how: test/traces/record.js on over-the-shoulder.test/test/page.html in the developer's Chrome (macOS, a regular mouse). Claude in Chrome acted between marks A and F with the developer's hand still; before and after, the developer rested, clicked fields and buttons with the mouse, typed, and left the window by the bottom edge. by: agent (whole-pixel pointer events and keys between marks A and F), hand (everything else: the mouse reports fractional coordinates).

events.label: hand only: click an empty spot to activate Chrome, then circles
C click Name straight after click, then type
D click Far, click Notes, type
E hover Far then click Far
F click Save, click Name, type
hand 1: rest, click Name, type abc
hand 2: rest, click Notes, type abc
hand 4: off the bottom edge and back, click Name, type abc
hand 5: click Save twice, Far twice
